$comment: Named auth profiles of skill_eval.py, picked only by --auth-profile (a live start requires the flag; the engine never detects a profile). skill_eval.py validates this file in code when a command needs a profile, never at import. personal-mac must keep exactly the values below. company bills per token: it lists the API-key variable names each engine may read and the gateway base URLs it may use; values are never read, printed or logged, except that a listed gateway variable's value is compared with its listed URLs. Codex has no per-call cap, so it is refused in API-key mode by code, not by this file. Outside the rule bundle: a change here does not move ruleset_sha256 (references/auth-and-cost.md).
source: plan.md:901-904 (H3); Appendix E Q7 (no provider or gateway until pinesky names one); gates.md G23 (this company default)

personal-mac.label: Personal Mac: subscription auth only (claude.ai and ChatGPT logins), account shim and subscription checks on

company.label: Company: API-key billing under a hard --budget-usd cap; only the listed key variables and gateways
